 Thailand Car Sales Rise 14.28% in September
 Less than 1 min read THTVS Thailand’s domestic vehicle sales rose 14.28% year-on-year to a five-month low of 55,254 units in September 2026, easing from 25.59% in the previous month, according to data from the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI). 
 Still, it marked the seventh straight month of growth, highlighting the continued recovery in domestic demand. 
 Meanwhile, vehicle production declined 6.08% year-on-year to 120,319 units, reversing a 10.93% increase in August. For the full year, car production is expected to reach 1.45 million units in 2026. 
 Thailand, Southeast Asia’s largest automotive production hub, also recorded a 4.55% increase in vehicle exports, rebounding from a 2.04% decline in the previous month.
